conventions.premium: coin premium multiplied by contemporaneous index_price
conventions.selection: 4 expiries nearest 14/35/75/150 days within 10-190 days; <=11 OTM strikes near log-moneyness targets -0.25 to 0.25

limitations: A bounded, sequential quote snapshot, not historical option data.
Top-of-book quotes indicate available sides at capture; fills, market impact and historical hedge performance are not observed.
USD equivalents use contemporaneous indices and zero-discount forward pricing; the hedge experiment does not replicate coin collateral.
Book timestamps establish snapshot freshness, not the last modification time of each standing order.
metadata.title: Options Volatility & Dynamic Hedging
metadata.data_classification: Observed Deribit option snapshots; hypothetical model prices and simulated hedge paths.
metadata.holdout_convention: Every fourth strike within each expiry withheld. Cross-sectional interpolation check, not a future-date forecasting test.

diagnostics.identifiability_note: Three deterministic starts and bid/ask perturbations; one snapshot does not establish stable or unique structural parameters.

BTC.risk_conventions: Hypothetical USD call F=K=100, T=30/365. Spot shock is relative. Vol shift changes sqrt(v0) and sqrt(theta); skew shifts rho. Greeks are Heston forward delta/gamma and vega per absolute change in sqrt(v0), theta held fixed. All results are precomputed.
